about_short_description.short_description: DeNet provides decentralized data storage and web hosting services.

product.name: DeNet Storage Protocol
product.description: A decentralized storage infrastructure protocol that distributes data across independent devices and maintains replicated storage without relying on a centralized data center.

product.name: DeNet Storage
product.description: A desktop and mobile application for storing and protecting personal data using the DeNet decentralized storage network.

product.name: DeNet Enterprise Storage
product.description: A decentralized data-storage service for organizations that need distributed storage for business and AI workloads.

product.name: DeNet Node
product.description: Node software that connects computers to the DeNet network, enabling participants to provide storage capacity and earn from storing user data.

product.name: DeNet Watcher Node
product.description: A mobile-oriented node product that allows participants to monitor the network and monetize available phone resources.

product.name: DeNet Consensus
product.description: A governance service for proposing and deciding changes to DeNet Storage Protocol settings and development.
